digest.component_or_area: LLM gate usage logging and telemetry
propositions: Gate runs persist no durable record of per-run model request counts or tool-call counts, preventing budget tuning and loop-vs-breadth diagnosis

The seven loop-detection fields (tool_calls, tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, request_limit, tool_calls_limit, finish_reason, top_repeated_tool_calls) are computed by failure_usage() and discarded at write time by record()
Local operator gate runs record nothing at all because REBAR_USAGE_LOG is unset, requiring instrumented re-runs to answer single measurement questions
The success path never computes tool-call shape or wall-clock duration, leaving only token counts
Existing usage_log machinery can be wired to both paths without building parallel mechanisms by calling run_shape() on success and persisting duration_s and ticket fields
Gate runs must default to persisting usage records to .rebar/usage.jsonl (when in_gate_session() is true) with rendered output showing tool-call total, distinct count, and loop-vs-breadth ratio
